title: The Stair Gate
transcript:
The same yellow gate. The same bend in the third bar.
He has stood here before, at night, with a card that worked.

The bell goes before his foot finds the second step down.
Torches on the landing. Someone shouting his number like a name.

PARTH:
"No. Not the chair. Not again."

A knee in his back. Concrete against his cheek.
Under the bell, a relay clicking in the wall. The alarm wire runs west, into the pump room.
He found the junction box once. He forgot. He always forgets.
